profile.name: Anil GC
profile.headline: Building Portfolio OS
profile.bio: I'm building an operating-system-style portfolio with React and Django REST Framework, with content managed through Django admin.
profile.about:
This portfolio brings together my current work in one desktop-inspired workspace.

The project combines a React and TypeScript frontend with a modular Django REST Framework backend. I'm focusing on a clean project structure, editable content, and a responsive experience.

projects.title: Portfolio OS
projects.summary: My desktop-inspired portfolio, built with React and Django REST Framework.
projects.description: An ongoing personal portfolio project with a React and TypeScript frontend and a modular Django REST Framework backend. It includes desktop-style navigation, project search, admin-managed content, a contact inbox, and configurable resume content. The frontend has a private hosted preview; the complete Django application currently runs locally, with a production deployment configuration prepared.
